# Calcula Monetam

> Free multi-currency calculator. It does math across currencies in one line (e.g. "10 usd - 5 eur + 3 g gold"), uses the median of several free exchange-rate sources, and shows the net amount after spread, commission, fixed fee and tax. Runs entirely in the browser; no account, no ads, works offline.

App: https://emirhan76demir.github.io/calcula-monetam/
Source: https://github.com/emirhan76demir/calcula-monetam
License: MIT

## Open a calculation by URL

- `?q=` prefills the editor with an expression and shows the result: https://emirhan76demir.github.io/calcula-monetam/?q=10+usd+-+5+eur
- `?to=` sets the target currency (ISO code): `?q=100+eur&to=USD`
- `?lang=` sets the interface language: tr, en, ru, zh, es, de, fr, ar, ja, pt
- `?theme=` sets the theme: moneta, tabula, spectra, tessera, pura

## Expression syntax

- Currencies by code, symbol or name in 10 languages: `10 usd`, `$10`, `10 dollars`, `10 dolar`, `10 €`
- Arithmetic and brackets: `+ - * / ( )`, also `x` between amounts
- Percentages: `250 eur + 18%`, `10% of 2,800 try`
- Convert a line: `1,500 try in usd`, `100 eur → gbp`, `= usd`
- Gold and silver: `3 g gold`, `1 oz silver`, `10 g 22 ayar`
- Turkish gold coins: `çeyrek`, `yarım altın`, `tam altın`, `ata altın`, `gremse`
- Variables and labels: `salary = 2,400 eur`, `hotel: 120 eur`
- Reverse calculation: `10,000 try net in usd` (amount needed to receive a net sum)

## Rate sources

Frankfurter (European Central Bank), ExchangeRate-API, Currency API, Gold API, and the Central Bank of Türkiye (updated on working days). Rates are informational and not live market quotes.
